# bunnynet_loadbalancer_group (Resource)

This resource manages a Load Balancer group in bunny.net.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "bunnynet_loadbalancer_group" "EU" {
  loadbalancer        = bunnynet_loadbalancer.test.id
  name                = "EU"
  method              = "Latency"
  priority            = 1
  healthcheck_enabled = true
  healthcheck_path    = "/health"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `loadbalancer` (Number) The ID of the Load Balancer.
- `name` (String) The name of the Load Balancer group.

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Indicates whether the Load Balancer group is enabled.
- `healthcheck_enabled` (Boolean) Indicates whether healthcheck will be performed against all origins.
- `healthcheck_path` (String) The path that will be called to determine if an origin is healthy.
- `latitude` (Number) The latitude of the Load Balancer group. Used in Load Balancers with method = "Geo".
- `longitude` (Number) The longitude of the Load Balancer group. Used for Load Balancers with method = "Geo"
- `method` (String) Options: `Latency`, `LeastConnections`, `RoundRobin`, `Weight`
- `priority` (Number) The priority of the Load Balancer group.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) The unique ID of the Load Balancer group.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import bunnynet_loadbalancer_group.test '123|EU'
```
